nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

Pick a **Mode**; only the images that mode uses are read:

| Mode | Uses |
|---|---|
| T2V | prompt |
| I2V (first frame) | First frame |
| Last frame | Last frame |
| First + last frame | both |
| R2V (references) | Reference 1 + 2 (write <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> in the prompt) |
| Multiframe | reference images + 3 guide frames at the times you set |
| ControlNet (pose) | Control video |

**Turbo** = 8 steps (FL2VA) / 4 steps (Ref2VA) with the turbo LoRAs; off = 20 steps.
Size: 0.4 MP = 864x480 (about 3:20 on the 3060), 0.9 MP = 1280x736.

Double-click the node to see every step. **Colours inside the node:** 🟦 load models · 🟩 your input (pose, face, frames) · 🟪 prompt + conditioning · 🟧 sampling · 🟨 decode + video · ⬛ settings + switches · 🟦‍ cyan = extras (side by side)
